hukum.faq.desc: Frequently asked questions about company legality services
hukum.faq.q1: How long is the NIB and OSS registration process?
hukum.faq.a1: With the correct documents, the process of issuing a Business Identification Number (NIB) through the risk-based OSS system usually takes 1-3 business days.
hukum.faq.q2: Why is my company required to register a trademark (HAKI)?
hukum.faq.a2: Registering a trademark gives you the exclusive legal right to use that mark, and protects your business from plagiarism or claims by other parties that could damage company assets.

haki.faq.title: FAQ regarding IPR Registration
haki.faq.desc: Frequently asked questions about Intellectual Property Rights
haki.faq.q1: What is IPR and what are its types?
haki.faq.a1: IPR (Intellectual Property Rights) is an exclusive right granted by the state to creators, inventors, or owners of intellectual works. Types of IPR commonly registered include: Trademarks, Copyrights, Patents, Industrial Designs, Trade Secrets, and Geographical Indications.
haki.faq.q2: How long is the trademark registration process?
haki.faq.a2: The trademark registration process at DJKI takes around 6-12 months, depending on whether there are objections from other parties. Once registered, trademark protection lasts for 10 years and can be renewed.
haki.faq.q3: What are the requirements for Copyright registration?
haki.faq.a3: Copyright registration requirements include: application form, statement of work ownership, sample of work (softcopy/hardcopy), creator's ID card, and deed of transfer of rights (if the creator is different from the applicant).
haki.faq.q4: Can the same trademark be registered for different classes?
haki.faq.a4: Yes, the same trademark can be registered in different classes of goods/services, as long as it is not substantially similar to registered trademarks belonging to other parties in the same class. We will help you determine the right class.
haki.faq.q5: What is the difference between a Patent and a Simple Patent?
haki.faq.a5: A Patent protects new inventions that have an inventive step and are industrially applicable (20 years of protection). A Simple Patent protects inventions that are developments of existing products/processes (10 years of protection) with a faster process.
haki.faq.a6: IPR registration in Indonesia is territorial (only valid in Indonesian territory). For international protection, you can apply through the Madrid Protocol system (for trademarks) or the Patent Cooperation Treaty/PCT (for patents).

nib.faq.title: FAQ regarding NIB & OSS
nib.faq.desc: Frequently asked questions about NIB and OSS registration
nib.faq.a1: NIB (Business Identification Number) is the official identity of a business actor issued through the OSS (Online Single Submission) system. OSS itself is an online integrated business licensing system managed by the government to simplify business legality processes in Indonesia.
nib.faq.q2: Are all businesses required to have an NIB?
nib.faq.a2: Yes, almost all types of businesses in Indonesia are required to have an NIB, both individual businesses and business entities. NIB functions as a business identity as well as a basic permit to run business activities legally.
nib.faq.q3: How long is the NIB & OSS creation process?
nib.faq.a3: The process of making NIB can be completed in 1 day if all data and documents are complete. However, for additional licensing through OSS, the time can vary depending on the type of business and its risk level.
nib.faq.q4: What data is needed to make an NIB?
nib.faq.a4: Some of the data required includes: ID card (KTP) & Tax ID (NPWP) of the business owner, business address, line of business (KBLI), active email, and company data if in the form of a business entity. Our team will help ensure all data matches the OSS system.
nib.faq.q5: Apakah bisa mengubah data NIB yang sudah terdaftar?
nib.faq.a5: Yes, data changes such as business address, line of business (KBLI), or other information can be made through the OSS system. We provide data update services to keep it in line with your current business conditions.
nib.faq.a6: Of course. We provide free consultations to help you understand the NIB & OSS process, as well as determine the business legality needs that best suit your business.

iso.faq.title: FAQ regarding ISO Certification
iso.faq.desc: Frequently asked questions about international management standards
iso.faq.q1: What is ISO certification and why is it important?
iso.faq.a1: ISO certification is an international recognition showing that a company has implemented a management system in accordance with globally recognized standards. This certification is important to increase credibility, customer trust, operational efficiency, and access to global markets.
iso.faq.q2: How long is the ISO certification process?
iso.faq.a2: The duration of the ISO certification process varies depending on the size of the company, complexity of the process, and readiness of the management system. It generally takes 3-6 months, which includes gap analysis, document preparation, implementation, up to the certification audit.
iso.faq.q3: What are the requirements to get ISO 9001?
iso.faq.a3: The main requirements of ISO 9001:2015 include: quality management system documentation (quality policy, quality objectives, SOPs), consistent process implementation, monitoring customer satisfaction, internal audits, and management review periodically.
iso.faq.q4: Is ISO certification valid for life?
iso.faq.a4: No. The ISO certificate is valid for 3 years. During that period, the company is required to undergo a surveillance audit every year to ensure the management system continues to run in accordance with the standard. After 3 years, the company must undergo recertification.
iso.faq.q5: Apakah perusahaan kecil bisa mendapatkan ISO?
iso.faq.a5: Yes, ISO certification can be applied to companies of various sizes, including SMEs. ISO standards are flexible and can be adapted to the scale and complexity of your business.
iso.faq.q6: Berapa biaya untuk mendapatkan sertifikasi ISO?
iso.faq.a6: The cost of ISO certification varies depending on the type of ISO, scope, number of employees, and complexity of business processes. We provide free consultations to give a cost estimate that suits your company's needs.

lkpm.hero.desc: Providing LKPM (Investment Activity Report) reporting services to help business actors fulfill investment reporting obligations through the OSS system accurately and on time.
lkpm.section1.label: 01. Legal Obligation
lkpm.section1.title: What is LKPM?
lkpm.section1.desc: LKPM (Investment Activity Report) is a periodic report that must be submitted by every business actor to BKPM through the OSS system. This report covers investment realization, workforce, and business development.
lkpm.section1.list3: Administrative sanctions for failure to report
lkpm.section2.label: 02. Professional Services
lkpm.section2.title: Drafting & Reporting of LKPM
lkpm.section2.desc: Our team is ready to help you compile investment realization and workforce data, input them into the OSS system, and ensure the report is delivered correctly before the specified deadline.
lkpm.section2.list2: Inputting report into the OSS system
lkpm.process.title: LKPM Reporting Process
lkpm.process.step1_desc: Collection of financial and operational data related to investment realization.
lkpm.process.step2_desc: Our team compiles the LKPM draft in accordance with BKPM provisions.
lkpm.process.step3_desc: Reporting to the BKPM OSS system and handing over official proof of receipt.
lkpm.faq.title: FAQ regarding LKPM Reporting
lkpm.faq.desc: Answers to frequently asked questions about LKPM reporting
lkpm.faq.q1: What is LKPM and who is required to report?
lkpm.faq.a1: LKPM (Investment Activity Report) is a periodic report that must be submitted by every business actor who has an NIB (Business Identification Number) to BKPM through the OSS system. This obligation applies to all business entities and individuals.
lkpm.faq.a2:
LKPM reporting is done every 3 months (quarterly) with the following deadlines:
                        - Quarter I (Jan-Mar): latest April 10
                        - Quarter II (Apr-Jun): latest July 10
                        - Quarter III (Jul-Sep): latest October 10
                        - Quarter IV (Oct-Dec): latest January 10 of the following year
lkpm.faq.q3: What are the sanctions for not reporting LKPM?
lkpm.faq.a3: Business actors who do not submit LKPM on time can be subject to administrative sanctions in the form of written warnings, suspension of business licenses, to revocation of business licenses in accordance with applicable BKPM regulations.
lkpm.faq.q4: Data apa saja yang dibutuhkan untuk pelaporan LKPM?
lkpm.faq.a4: The data required includes: investment realization (land, buildings, machinery, working capital), number of workers (male/female, local/foreign), production/sales value, and business constraints faced during the reporting period.
lkpm.faq.a5: Yes, if there is no investment realization or business activity during the reporting period, you are still required to report LKPM with a "NIL" status. This is important to maintain your business compliance status in the OSS system.
lkpm.faq.q6: Bagaimana jika saya sudah terlambat melapor beberapa periode?
lkpm.faq.a6: Don't worry. Our team can help you make retrospective reports (backlog) for missed periods, as well as provide assistance to prevent future delays.

pailit.section1.desc: A Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy is an official document issued by the Commercial Court stating that a person or business entity is not in bankruptcy or Suspension of Debt Payment Obligations (PKPU).
pailit.section1.list1: Mandatory requirement for government project tenders

pailit.faq.title: FAQ regarding Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy
pailit.faq.desc: Frequently asked questions about the Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy
pailit.faq.q1: What is a Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy?
pailit.faq.a1: A Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy is an official document issued by the Commercial Court stating that a person (individual) or legal entity (company) is not recorded in the list of parties in bankruptcy or Suspension of Debt Payment Obligations (PKPU) proceedings.
pailit.faq.q2: Kapan Surat Keterangan Tidak Pailit dibutuhkan?
pailit.faq.a2: This document is generally required for: participating in government project tenders/auctions, applying for bank loans/credit, company merger & acquisition processes, due diligence of prospective business partners, and other administrative requirements.
pailit.faq.q3: Berapa lama proses pengurusan SK Tidak Pailit?
pailit.faq.a3: The process of obtaining a Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy generally takes 3-5 business days after all required documents are complete. We will help speed up the process by ensuring all requirements are met.
pailit.faq.q4: Apa saja persyaratan pengurusan SK Tidak Pailit?
pailit.faq.a4: For individuals: Copy of ID card (KTP) and Tax ID (NPWP). For companies: Deed of Establishment, Kemenkumham Decree, Company Tax ID (NPWP), Director's ID card (KTP) and Tax ID (NPWP). Requirements may differ depending on the local Commercial Court.
pailit.faq.q5: Apakah SK Tidak Pailit memiliki masa berlaku?
pailit.faq.a5: The Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy does not have a specifically stated validity period. However, generally, the requesting agency sets a deadline of 3-6 months from the date of issue.
pailit.faq.q6: Di Pengadilan Niaga mana saja bisa mengurus?
pailit.faq.a6: The Certificate of Non-Bankruptcy can be processed at the Commercial Court whose jurisdiction covers the applicant's domicile. Currently, there are 5 Commercial Courts in Indonesia: Central Jakarta, Surabaya, Semarang, Medan, and Makassar. We can assist in processing at all these locations.

drafting.faq.title: FAQ regarding Our Services
drafting.faq.desc: Frequently asked questions about compiling and reviewing contracts
drafting.faq.q1: What is the importance of a written agreement in business?
drafting.faq.a1: A written agreement serves as valid evidence in the eyes of the law if a dispute occurs in the future. In addition, a clear and comprehensive agreement provides legal certainty, regulates the rights and obligations of the parties, and minimizes potential misunderstandings.
drafting.faq.q2: What is the difference between drafting and reviewing an agreement?
drafting.faq.a2: Drafting is the process of compiling an agreement from scratch (zero) in accordance with the client's needs and wishes. Review is the process of examining and analyzing an existing agreement draft (usually made by another party) to identify risks and provide recommendations for changes.
drafting.faq.q3: Berapa lama proses drafting atau review perjanjian?
drafting.faq.a3: Processing time depends on the complexity of the agreement. For standard agreements, the drafting or review process can be completed in 3-5 business days. For complex agreements such as joint ventures or M&As, the time required can be 1-2 weeks.
drafting.faq.a4: Yes, we provide agreement drafting and review services in two languages (Indonesian and English) to meet the needs of cross-border business transactions. Bilingual agreements are made by paying attention to the suitability of legal terminology in both languages.
drafting.faq.q5: Klausul apa saja yang wajib ada dalam perjanjian bisnis?
drafting.faq.a5: There are at least some important clauses: Identity of the Parties, Maksud and Purpose, Rights and Obligations, Time Period, Contract Value and Method of Payment, Default and Sanctions, Force Majeure, Dispute Resolution, and Closing Provisions.
drafting.faq.q6: Apakah perjanjian di bawah tangan sah secara hukum?
drafting.faq.a6: Yes, a private agreement (not made before a notary) remains valid and legally binding on the parties. However, for certain agreements such as PT establishment, land purchase, or credit agreement with collateral, it must be made in the form of a notarial deed.

cv.faq_q1: What is the difference between CV and PT?
cv.faq_a1: CV (Commanditaire Vennootschap) has two types of partners: active partners who manage the company and passive partners who only invest capital. While PT has a more formal shareholder and board of directors structure. CV is more suitable for small-medium scale businesses with working partners.
cv.faq_q2: How long is the CV establishment process?
cv.faq_a2: With complete documents, the CV establishment process takes around 7-14 working days, depending on the speed of notary deed creation and legalization from Kemenkumham.
cv.faq_q3: Can a CV have more than 2 partners?
cv.faq_a3: Yes, a CV can have more than 2 partners. At least 1 active partner and 1 passive partner are required. The more partners, the greater the potential capital collected.
cv.faq_q4: Is a CV subject to corporate tax?
cv.faq_a4: Yes, CV as a business entity is required to have a corporate Tax ID and report Corporate Annual Tax. However, the tax calculation is different from PT because CV does not have as strict a separation of wealth as PT.

pt_per.faq_q1: What are the main requirements to establish a PT Perorangan?
pt_per.faq_a1: The founder must be an Indonesian Citizen (WNI) aged at least 21 years or married, has not established a PT Perorangan in the last 1 year, and has an active ID (KTP) and Tax ID (NPWP). This type of PT is usually limited to Micro and Small Enterprises (UMK) criteria whose capital does not exceed a certain percentage.
pt_per.faq_q2: How long does it take until the certificate is issued?
pt_per.faq_a2: With complete and eligible files, the process of administrative completion and electronic registration can be completed very quickly—depending on how fast you provide valid data (Generally ranges from 2 hours to 5 business days).
pt_per.faq_q3: Do I need to have a physical building address?
pt_per.faq_a3: Every PT, including a PT Perorangan, is required to include a clear registered office address. However, if you do not have a commercial building, you can rent a legal 'Virtual Office' service in a business zone to minimize operational capital limits.
pt_per.faq_q4: What is the difference between a Regular PT and PT Perorangan?
pt_per.faq_a4: A regular PT must be established by at least 2 independent shareholders before a Notary, while a PT Perorangan can stand with just 1 single director. The bureaucracy is much more practical as you only need to register the Statement of Establishment electronically to Kemenkumham RI.

pt_pma.faq_q1: What is a PT PMA and who can establish it?
pt_pma.faq_a1: PT PMA (Foreign Direct Investment) is a limited liability company established by foreign investors or foreign parties who want to invest capital in Indonesia. The founders can be foreign citizens or foreign companies collaborating with Indonesian citizens according to BKPM provisions.
pt_pma.faq_q2: What is the minimum investment for a PT PMA?
pt_pma.faq_a2: According to the latest BKPM rules, the minimum investment value for a PT PMA is IDR 10 Billion excluding land and buildings, with a minimum paid-up capital of IDR 2.5 Billion.
pt_pma.faq_q3: How long is the PT PMA establishment process?

pt_pma.faq_q4: Can a foreign citizen become a director of a PT PMA?
pt_pma.faq_a4: Yes, foreign citizens are allowed to be directors in a PT PMA, but they must have a KITAS (limited stay permit) and comply with TKA (Foreign Worker) regulations.

yayasan.faq_q2: What is the minimum capital to establish a Yayasan?

yayasan.faq_a4: A Yayasan has three main bodies: Governing Board (Pembina - sets policies), Supervisory Board (Pengawas - oversees managers), and Executive Board (Pengurus - runs activities). Minimum of 3 people.
